# Use the current notification options object rather than the old positional method

Entry 916 adds type to the header showErrorNotification(titleStringID, textStringID, type) and the step forwarding method. The accepted AccountHubStep forwards a showNotification options object to its header, and the header supports title, description, localized IDs, error, severity and expanded state. Use the current options contract for new callers. An options object keeps these independent optional values named; this is a local API pattern rather than a demand to replace every positional function.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
